nodes.title: MOSS · literal layout JSON · 1024²

widgets_values:
Use ComfyUI 0.42.1 or newer. Native MOSS support was added in 0.42.0; 0.42.1 fixes crashes affecting the MOSS template. Desktop: update the engine for this instance through Manage > Update, then restart. No nightly engine is required.

MOSS regular SFT · separated components

Select moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors, qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors (CLIP type moss_image), and flux2-vae_small.safetensors in the three loaders.

50 steps, CFG 3, Euler/simple, native shift 5. SLG is omitted for this regular-SFT baseline. No ModelSamplingSD3 override. Prompt Palette controls the connected sampler seed.

For editable fields: Settings > Power tools > Adjustable Recipe Workspace > Layouts > MOSS. Layout JSON uses centered pixel boxes; match its canvas dimensions.

Turbo AIO has its own example: prompt_palette_moss_turbo_aio.json. Its publisher specifies Load Checkpoint, 8 steps, CFG 1, Euler/simple. Do not use this regular-SFT sampling recipe for Turbo. Guide: MOSS_PROMPTING.md.

Graph wiring and real checkpoint-header detection checked; GPU loading/inference not run here.
